scientific.integrity: The result follows from an exact SVD reduction of the original additive Shampoo accumulators under a stationary matrix gradient. Every finite-time singular value, condition number, and polar-limit error is obtained in closed form and independently replayed numerically.
limitations: Original additive matrix Shampoo without momentum, EMA, grafting, or stale root refresh.
The result concerns gradient-spectrum geometry rather than nonlinear global convergence.

title: Exact singular-value equalization law for Shampoo under a stationary gradient
